releaseNotes:
Official Release v1.3.136:
- PROMINENT SAVE BUTTON: Added prominent SAVE button in the header (always visible beside close button) and in the footer of the product edit modal.
- 100% DECIMAL INPUT & KEYBOARD FIX: Resolved issue where pressing decimal dot '.' on the touch keypad cleared the input value when modifying product prices.
- SEAMLESS PRICE EDITING: Converted strict number inputs to decimal inputs to allow natural progressive typing (e.g. '2.', '2.50') without browser reset.
- STABLE VIRTUAL KEYBOARD: Verified smooth behavior on Clear, Backspace, numbers, and decimal points across all modals.
- 100% Quality Standard: 0 errors and 0 warnings verified across all integrity auditors.
